review_candidates.title: Principal Systems Engineer
review_candidates.company: Massey University - Te Kunenga ki Pūrehuroa
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Minimum 6 years' experience in a senior or principal engineering role across enterprise platforms such as Microsoft 365, Linux, or equivalent enterprise services. Cloud AI services such as Azure AI, with an understanding of data privacy and responsible AI. Appointment to this role is subject to a Ministry of Justice criminal and traffic convictions check, an Equifax credit history check, and validation of qualifications. Desired Skills and Experience Enterprise Architecture Platform Engineering
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Generous with your expertise - you mentor, support and lift the people around you. Minimum 6 years' experience in a senior or principal engineering role across enterprise platforms such as Microsoft 365, Linux, or equivalent enterprise services. Hands-on experience across several of: Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams), Entra ID / Active Directory, Power Platform, Azure or equivalent cloud services, databases and data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Linux and scripting (Bash/Python/PowerShell), and Microsoft Purview or Defender. Appointment to this role is subject to a Ministry of Justice criminal and traffic convictions check, an Equifax credit history check, and validation of qualifications.
